title.zh: Why Mastercard’s $25 billion crypto expansion isn’t what it seems
title.en: Why Mastercard’s $25 billion crypto expansion isn’t what it seems

current_state.zh: SoFi Bank and Mastercard have launched live SoFiUSD settlement for SoFi's debit and credit card program, letting participating merchants receive bank-account dollars without holding the token, backed by a projected $25B+ in annualized card volume that has not been matched with disclosed actual settled amounts.
